roles.card: 5:7; same main size in all packs; mini/preview are explicit roles
roles.checker: standard token fitted into a board cell
roles.board: largest standard board fitting its slot; cells derive from board/rules
roles.control: standard 44px base touch control; dense 32/36, large 48/56
roles.player: standard avatar, typography, padding; panel width responsive
roles.zone: responsive container; standard padding/gaps, fixed scene
roles.art: SVG internal coordinates and skin exclusion geometry retained

componentRoles.selection: same viewport and stop => same width across packs
largest standard <= main and <= grid slot
standard <= cell footprint and selected level
default control >=32; text may expand width
standard preferred width capped by viewport
largest standard fitting slot, proportional cells; below160 continuous emergency fit
responsive area with standard padding/gap; frozen during moves
explicit large preview role; no user actions
positive borders remain at least1px; focus ring uses same row

layoutGrids.selection: Real viewport width and orientation; interface density never changes library tile count
guides: zone padding/content boxes with measured dimensions
exceptions: Board cells and tableau columns follow game rules, not page columns
Optical alignment of artwork does not change hit geometry
Overlay never receives input or occupies layout space

library.sidebar: phone portrait dock; landscape side menu; wide viewport side menu

units.intrinsicArt: asset viewBox coordinates, scaled once with outer component

motion.distancePolicy: duration-based; observed px/s depends on path length; no global constant speed

policies.modalAppearance: Immediate mount/removal; modal backdrop blur7px, no added opening delay. Context game notice pop160ms.
policies.reducedMotion: CSS animations/transitions disabled; GameFlow duration0. Readable reveal/speech holds and bot scheduling remain; dice opacity feedback may remain <=180ms.
policies.font: System font stack. Standard text sizes from size families; intrinsic card text scales with its asset.
policies.layers: Existing semantic stack inventoried; portal ownership differs, so equal z-index across contexts cannot be normalized mechanically.
policies.palette: themes/light.json and themes/dark.json are canonical semantic colors; custom presets and material/art colors remain separate.
policies.borders: Physical UI borders min1px; intrinsic SVG rims scale proportionally once.
policies.fallbacks: Literal fallbacks preserve standalone component/old host operation; catalogue values win in the application.

composition.selection: Existing viewApi3 family/focus/hand/surface metadata; never game ID. Profiles label current layout; they do not infer rules or authorization.

profiles.compact: actions may move to header-landscape by explicit pack contract
profiles.wide: field remains primary, fixed standard cards

profiles.compact: cropped opponent hands, scroll local hand; seat fallback by geometry
profiles.wide: seats around field where space permits
row or ring from seating preference

profiles.compact: standard board floor to fit; board cells derived; actions reserved if requested
profiles.wide: ring/row seats; square or explicit aspect

profiles.compact: local controls and private hand primary

profiles.wide: no private hand or unauthorized controls

slots.persistent: layout-actions within self or header by explicit landscape contract
slots.participant: player-content buttons; participant card min size and wrapping
slots.targetConfirmation: player-target-confirm anchored to selected participant/hand, outside field flow
slots.badge: avatar positions or content badges; preserve readable counter and name
slots.handoff: pass-device-button in reserved controls; attention stops with reduced motion

contextActions.appearance: Use existing actionReserve and stable self zone; selection must not refit field. Overlay may not clip or cover actionable targets.
contextActions.overflow: Wrap inside reserved controls, scroll hand/participant region, change seating only on allowed layout refresh. Do not silently shrink card to arbitrary size.
contextActions.privacy: Visible controls follow projected legal choices; slot visibility does not grant authority.

composition.reflow: Existing fixed-layout lock remains. Viewport/scale/skin changes and explicit allowLayoutChange only. Empty hand must not collapse scene during a move.

hands.units: CSS px for physical clearances; ratios/viewBox for skin stacking; degrees for arc

variants.contract: Standard full-size card. Peek=max(skin horizontal exposure, measured rank+suit clearance); horizontal scroll when long. No arbitrary card shrink.
Same width and overlap as row. Curve relative to visible track center; per-card rotate and translate; bounds reserved by CSS.
Standard domino4:7, no fan hiding pips, horizontal scroll.
Separate explicit mini role. Open minimum step; hidden hand may overlap more. Cropped viewport reserves controls.
Vertical exposed step=card height*skin vertical; protected rank/suit regions remain readable. Stack drag retains relative offsets.
Closed offset separate from open. Back needs no exposed rank.
Reserve axis at skin change; overlap derives from selected face geometry, not next move.

hands.protectedZones: Normalized x/y/width/height per skin manifest; never round to layout4px. These and main/compact art remain asset-owned.
hands.selection: Selection/drag adds independent transform and must not overwrite arc rotation or seat transform.
hands.hitTargets: Small exposure is a card selection/drag affordance; physical phone acceptance remains required.

extensibleZones.status: proposal and review prototype; not a new viewApi version and not implemented game rules

groups.mixed: Several separately labelled groups inside hand or tableau; preserve order, focus, scroll and stable dimensions; no assumption of one deck or one card ratio.

inspection.source: Only the current authorized projection; never Session.export, hidden faces, unrevealed tile IDs or a second rules calculation.
inspection.input: Explicit inspect button / keyboard action; must not steal normal drag or tooltip hold.
inspection.view: Read-only enlarged clone of projected render/art, accessible close/Escape, focus return and separate bounded pan/zoom.
inspection.coordinates: Viewport zoom/pan are presentation state; map input through inverse viewport transform. Scaling pieces remains discrete; inspection zoom is independent.
inspection.overlay: Token-on-card uses normalized card-local anchors and named layers; stacks have count and accessible labels; no fixed-screen placement.

tilePlacement.status: future generic contract, illustrative local fixture
tilePlacement.supply: Count/back-only until rules project the drawn tile. Draw, rotate, preview, commit, cancel are separate intents.
tilePlacement.rotation: Discrete allowed angles from projected choices; square example0/90/180/270. Rotation changes local tile art/ports; board pan/zoom is independent.
tilePlacement.board: Integer or explicit topology coordinates; snap only to projected legal cells. Tile footprint belongs to tile family; existing card5:7 is not reused.
tilePlacement.input: Screen->inverse viewport->board coordinates->allowed target; host validates commit and rotation.
tilePlacement.preview: Ghost is presentation only; no occupancy/score mutation before durable accepted command.
tilePlacement.occupants: Meeples/tokens use tile-local normalized anchor/layer; rotation affects attached anchors, not unrelated UI labels.
tilePlacement.zoom: Scrollable/inspectable growing field, viewport culling without losing legal targets; no auto-fit jump on every placement.

tileDiscovery.example: Movement into unexplored tile; no game requested
tileDiscovery.privacy: Unknown cell carries only authorized back/geometry, not hidden face, terrain ID or URL in DOM/dataset.
sequence: release input after required viewing time
tileDiscovery.timing: Reveal uses shared effectTimes; instant/reduced motion preserves meaningful information and necessary confirmation.
tileDiscovery.replay: Use authorized history projection for each revision; do not reconstruct hidden map.
tileDiscovery.geometry: Revealing a face keeps the tile footprint, board origin and viewport stable; no relayout of entire field.

acceptance: mixed public/private groups do not disclose hidden data
counter-only group does not require rendering every object
inspect does not change game state or lose focus
illegal drop cancels without state mutation
reveal does not leak before authority commit
context actions remain reachable and do not push the field

uiBaseline.policy: Original application CSS and natural100% layout; legacy UI zoom is separate from discrete game-piece scaling
